The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

The bug: the combinational `grant` logic set the next-cycle pointer `idx` to the granted requester's index `i` instead of `(i+1) mod 4`, so with all requesters active the pointer never advanced and requester 0 was granted every cycle. I corrected `idx` in all four `ptr` cases to the next index, and also fixed the search order in the `ptr == 2` branch, which had checked `req[1]` before `req[0]` instead of the correct wrap order (2, 3, 0, 1).
